Committee: Governmental Affairs
Sponsor: Givhan
Analyst: JT Mathis
Date: 01/18/2022
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 77 as introduced could increase the financial obligations of state agencies and institutions by a small undetermined amount that would be dependent upon the number of state agencies and institutions that purchase a United States flag or Alabama flag manufactured in the United States of America and the difference in the cost of flags manufactured outside of the United States of America.
Jimmy Holley, Chairperson
Governmental Affairs

Committee: State Government
Sponsor: Givhan
Analyst: JT Mathis
Date: 02/04/2022
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 77 as passed the Senate could increase the obligations of state agencies and institutions by a small undetermined amount dependent upon the difference in the cost of a United States flag or Alabama flag manufactured in the United States of America purchased by these entities and the cost of flags manufactured outside of the United States of America otherwise purchased by these state entities.
Chris Pringle, Chair
State Government

Committee: Public Safety and Homeland Security
Sponsor: Allen
Analyst: John Friedenreich
Date: 02/14/2022
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 113 as passed the Senate could increase receipts to the State General Fund and municipal general funds from fines; increase receipts to the State General Fund, county general funds, municipal general funds, and other funds to which court costs are deposited; and could increase the obligations of the State General Fund, district attorneys, and local jails by an undetermined amount dependent upon the number of persons that violate the prohibitions related to electric bicycles provided by this bill and the penalties imposed.
Allen Treadaway, Chair
Public Safety and Homeland Security
